integrity: The exact finite law, mean, fixed-palette law and growing-palette CLT are proved in RESULT.md. Standalone exact enumeration in check.py corroborates finite examples but does not independently certify the asymptotic proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number r>=3 of parts with positive asymptotic proportions, uniform independent initial colors, independent continuous priorities and k_n log n=o(n) for the Gaussian result. The threshold is sufficient, not proved optimal. Novelty is assessed against examined sources, not all historical mathematical literature; no independent audit has been performed.
title: Multipartite random-priority peaks: exact colored-run laws and a growing-palette Gaussian limit
